tables.title: will vs (be) going to - الفرق
rows: Futurologists predict that life will be very different.
Amal has bought a new book. Tonight she is going to stay at home and start reading it.
I think our team will win the match.
We are going to attend a football match next Saturday.
Scientists and researchers will find cure for many diseases.
Tonight we are going to have a birthday party for our mother.
tables.explanation: نستخدم 'will' للتنبؤات بدون دليل والقرارات الفورية. نستخدم '(be) going to' للتنبؤات مع دليل والخطط المسبقة.
tables.examples: I think our team will win the match. / We are going to attend a football match next Saturday.

tables.title: Future with will - الصيغة
tables.explanation: نستخدم 'will' للتنبؤات المستقبلية والقرارات الفورية. النفي: will not = won't. السؤال: نضع will قبل الفاعل.
tables.examples: I think our team will win the match. / Futurologists predict that life will be very different.

tables.title: Future with (be) going to - الصيغة
rows: Tonight she is going to stay at home.
Subject + am/is/are + not + going to + Verb 1
I am not going to attend the match.
Are you going to visit Aleppo?
tables.explanation: نستخدم '(be) going to' للخطط المسبقة والتنبؤات مع دليل ملموس.
tables.examples: We are going to have a birthday party for our mother. / Tonight we are going to have a birthday party for our mother.

tables.title: Comparatives (صفات المقارنة)
rows: Are e-books better than traditional ones?
Living on the moon will be more comfortable.
Living on the moon will be easier.
Property in Homs is cheaper than property in Damascus.
Life will be more difficult for some people.
tables.explanation: للمقارنة بين شيئين نستخدم: صفة + er (للصفات القصيرة) أو more + صفة (للصفات الطويلة) + than.
tables.examples: E-books are better than traditional books. / Life on the moon will be easier than in a space station.

tables.title: Conjunctions (أدوات الربط)
rows: I will be a teacher because it's my favourite subject.
We will have a nice house but it will not be very big.
I'm interested in music, so I will have a wonderful collection.
Everyone will have education, health, home and food.
People will have better education because of technology.
He will start his job as soon as he graduates.
tables.explanation: أدوات الربط تستخدم لربط الجمل والكلمات.
tables.examples: I will be an English teacher because it's my favourite subject. / We have a nice house but it is not big.

tables.title: Prepositions (حروف الجر)
tables.explanation: حروف الجر لها استخدامات محددة حسب السياق.
tables.examples: new types of crops / because of technology / on the roofs of buildings

tables.title: Question Formation (تكوين السؤال)
rows: What, Who, Where, When, Why, How long, How often, ...
I, you, he, she, it, we, they, ...
المصدر (مع will) أو التصريف الثالث (مع have/has)
tables.explanation: لتحويل أي جملة إلى سؤال، نتبع الخطوات: ١- كلمة السؤال ٢- الفعل المساعد ٣- الفاعل ٤- الفعل الرئيسي ٥- باقي الجملة ثم علامة الاستفهام.
tables.examples:
Why will people have better education?
People will have better education because of technology.

Who will robots help?
Robots will help doctors.

What will the space city be like?
The space city will be like a gigantic glass wheel.

How often will they take a pill?
They will take a pill three times a day.

What will the weather be like tomorrow?
The weather will be dreadful tomorrow.

tables.title: Articles a / an (أدوات التنكير)
rows: قبل الكلمات التي تبدأ بحرف ساكن (consonant sound)
a job, a doctor, a teacher
قبل الكلمات التي تبدأ بحرف علة (vowel sound)
an architect, an English teacher, an astronaut
tables.explanation: نستخدم 'a' قبل الكلمات التي تبدأ بصوت ساكن، و 'an' قبل الكلمات التي تبدأ بصوت علة (a, e, i, o, u).
tables.examples: Malik wants to become an architect. / He would like to have a job to serve his country.

tables.title: Possessive Pronouns (ضمائر الملكية)
tables.explanation: ضمائر الملكية تأتي قبل الاسم للدلالة على الملكية.
tables.examples: He will run his library in his country.

tables.title: Relative Pronouns - who (ضمائر الوصل)
rows: Malik would like to help poor people who can't afford money.
tables.examples: Malik would like to help poor people who can't afford money to build their houses.

tables.title: Pronunciation - /e/ vs /i:/
tables.explanation: الصوت القصير /e/ يظهر في كلمات مثل (men, red, met) والصوت الطويل /i:/ يظهر في كلمات مثل (mean, read, meet). جميع الأمثلة مأخوذة من تمرين النطق في كتاب الطالب صفحة 23.
tables.examples: Listen and repeat: men vs mean, red vs read, met vs meet.
